prompt: From your git repository root, generate a detailed changelog Markdown file named CHANGELOG.md that includes all commits between 2024-03-01 and 2024-03-15. The changelog must: 1) Categorize commits into New Features, Improvements, Bug Fixes, Breaking Changes, and Security sections. 2) Exclude internal commits such as those containing keywords like "refactor", "test", or "docs". 3) Translate technical commit messages into clear, user-friendly descriptions suitable for customer-facing release notes. 4) Format the changelog with a top-level heading containing the date range (March 1–15, 2024) and subheadings with icons for each category (e.g. "## ✨ New Features"). 5) Use bullet points for each entry, with concise but informative text. 6) Save the output exactly in the file CHANGELOG.md in Markdown format. You must handle multiple commits per category and ensure clarity and consistent style throughout.
